verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official, first-party MCP server that lets AI assistants such as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code securely manage incidents and fetch account data. It also lists an Anthropic Claude Connector, and its Insights Agent offers on-demand conversational insights, so users can operate core functions through natural-language requests. missing for 10: a documented native in-product natural-language command interface beyond analytics-focused conversation, detail on which operations the MCP tools cover, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation working in practice.
